entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Clan coffer activity alerts are always-on, no config checkbox.
entries.detail: Unlike loot sharing and death screenshots, which are individually toggleable per player, clan coffer deposit/withdraw alerts have no opt-out. Rationale: coffer activity reflects clan-owned funds and clan business, not personal player activity, so there's less privacy rationale for letting a player disable it.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Screenshot/summary delivery routes through catabot's HTTP API, not raw Discord webhook URLs in plugin config.
entries.detail: A new upload endpoint will be added to catabot for the plugin to POST screenshots and summaries to, targeting a Discord channel ID. Rationale: keeps Discord bot credentials server-side only, consistent with the existing architecture where catabot already hosts /events and /signup for this plugin rather than the plugin talking to Discord directly.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Open item carried into planning: loot value detection mechanism and death-detection hook still need to be resolved.
entries.detail: Need to determine the exact mechanism for loot value detection (drop tracking + GE value lookup + non-stackable/non-currency filter, threshold 1.5m gp) and identify the death-detection hook available in the RuneLite client API. Resolve during plan-task.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Verified RuneLite API signatures against the locally cached client-1.12.35.jar / runelite-api-1.12.35.jar before writing any listener code.
entries.detail: Used javap against ~/.gradle/caches to confirm actual signatures rather than assuming: net.runelite.client.events.NpcLootReceived/PlayerLootReceived (not the loottracker-plugin-only LootReceived, which requires that separate plugin to be enabled), ActorDeath.getActor(), ChatMessage.getType()/getMessage() with ChatMessageType.CLAN_MESSAGE, DrawManager.requestNextFrameListener(Consumer<Image>), ImageUtil.bufferedImageFromImage(Image), ItemManager.getItemPrice(int)/getItemComposition(int), ItemComposition.isStackable(), and EventBus.register(Object)/unregister(Object).

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: AlertsApiClient does not reuse EventsApiClient's private generic enqueue()/handleResponse() helper - it has its own response handling.
entries.detail: EventsApiClient's helper is JSON-response-specific (Gson.fromJson into a Class<T>), which doesn't fit a Void/no-body multipart response well. AlertsApiClient duplicates the same 401/unsuccessful/network error classification inline instead. Flagged per PLAN.md Step 4's anticipated deviation note. Also duplicates the API_BASE constant string rather than extracting a shared constant, matching EventsApiClient's existing self-contained-class style (no shared API-config class exists yet in this codebase).

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: CofferAlertListener's chat-message detection (ChatMessageType.CLAN_MESSAGE + regex for "coffer" and "deposit"/"withdr") is an assumption, not verified against a live clan coffer transaction.
entries.detail: No test account/live game session was available during execution to trigger a real coffer deposit/withdraw and observe the exact chat type and wording. The regex is intentionally loose (matches on 'coffer' plus a deposit/withdraw verb stem) to tolerate wording variance, but the ChatMessageType itself (assumed CLAN_MESSAGE, the type used for clan broadcast/system messages) needs manual confirmation - see PLAN.md Step 10 manual QA.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Step 10 QA: ran ./gradlew compileJava - builds clean, confirming all new RuneLite API usage compiles against client-1.12.35. Full in-game verification (loot/death/coffer firing correctly, both toggles gating correctly, and actual Discord delivery) could not be done in this session - no live RuneLite client/game session or working catabot /alerts endpoint available. Manual in-game QA and end-to-end delivery testing (once the companion catabot task lands) is still outstanding.
entries.detail: Verified: `.\gradlew.bat compileJava` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Also spot-checked indentation/brace style on the new alerts/ files (tabs, Allman braces) against conventions.json. Not verified: live NpcLootReceived/PlayerLootReceived/ActorDeath/ChatMessage firing behavior, the 1.5m/non-stackable filter against a real drop, the coffer regex against a real coffer transaction message, or actual message delivery to Discord (blocked on the catabot plugin-alerts-endpoint task).

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Companion catabot /alerts endpoint now exists (requirePluginToken-gated, kind-to-channel-ID mapping server-side per WL-2), unblocking end-to-end testing. Live-tested all three alert kinds against production catabot/Discord via ./gradlew run: loot (with VALUE_THRESHOLD_GP temporarily lowered to 1L to force a qualifying drop, then reverted to 1_500_000L), death (real in-client death), and coffer (real coffer transaction, confirming the ChatMessageType.CLAN_MESSAGE assumption from WL-6 was correct). All three posted successfully to their real Discord channels.
entries.detail: Also added rate limiting to catabot's HTTP API (all /events, /signup, /checkin, /alerts routes) as a related hardening pass ahead of a planned RuneLite Plugin Hub submission - tracked in catabot's own repo, not this task's scope.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: lootSharingEnabled and deathScreenshotsEnabled now default to false (opt-in), not true as originally planned in Step 1 / WL's original plan text.
entries.detail: Post-live-test decision: default every player out of loot-sharing and death-screenshot alerts rather than auto-enrolling them, so sharing personal moments to a clan channel is something each player opts into rather than has to opt out of. Coffer alerts (WL-1, always-on) are unaffected - that decision stands as clan-owned activity, not personal.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: Added a new deathMessage config item (free-text) beyond the original plan's scope, letting players customize the text posted alongside their death screenshot (e.g. "died being silly") instead of the fixed "Died." string.
entries.detail: New @ConfigItem String deathMessage (position 4, default "") on CatastrophicEventsConfig. DeathAlertListener uses it when non-blank, falling back to the original "Died." literal otherwise. No server-side change needed - catabot already sends alert content with allowedMentions: { parse: [] }, so a free-text field can't be used to ping @everyone/roles.

entries.author: system
entries.detail: No open blockers. Definition of done confirmed: all plan steps complete plus WL-9/WL-10 deviations, conventions followed, no automated tests (consistent with this repo's existing TD-001 convention - manual QA is the accepted bar), no new concerns beyond what's logged here. Dev UAT: live end-to-end testing of loot/death/coffer alerts against production, and a second live pass confirming the opt-in defaults and the new Death message field render/behave correctly in RuneLite's native config panel. Both confirmed by the developer.
